title: The Clinical Utility of QuantiFERON in the Diagnosis of Active Tuberculosis
brief_summary: The investigators will evaluate the usefulness of QuantiFERON-TB Gold in-tube (QFT) in the diagnosis of active tuberculosis in young adults group, highly clinically suspected tuberculosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All clinically and radiologically suspected TB patients from 20 to 29 years old who visited the Armed Forces Capital Hospital

Exclusion Criteria:

* Soldiers who do not agree with study protocol
